qaAccuracy.sampleNote: Full-set sequential QA grading (~2,040 LongMemEval+LoCoMo questions x [answer + judge], DOUBLED by the full-haystack filesystem control; the harness grades strictly sequentially) measured ~6-12h per pass, ~13-24h across both cross-judge passes on this machine -- genuinely infeasible in a single session. Per the J1 protocol's disclosed-subset fallback (full is the default; silent subsetting is forbidden), QA accuracy was measured on a CATEGORY-STRATIFIED subset: exactly 20 LongMemEval items per question_type (120 of 500, all 6 categories) + 1 LoCoMo sample truncated to 15 QA (LoCoMo is comparability-only, never headlined). Retrieval recall@k/MRR above is on the FULL 500+10 set. Selection method: first-N-per-category in file order (deterministic). The full published head-to-head on the complete set is Phase 104 (PROVE). Per-category n=20 -> ~+-11pt SE.
